### Borea v0.6.25

A patch release for the crash notice and the memory Borea keeps after its start. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Fixed

- The notice that the game closed unexpectedly now also shows at the start of Borea for the instance you played last, not only for the active instance. So it also shows after Borea closed itself while the game ran.

#### Improved

- Shortly after its start, once it is idle, Borea gives back the memory it used to load the index and the Home page.

Full changelog: [v0.6.24...v0.6.25](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.24...v0.6.25)
